learning.sceneConnection: 是否拥有删除权限由对白明确说明，不从图标或人物动作推断。
learning.association: 是否拥有删除权限由对白明确说明，不从图标或人物动作推断。
learning.collocation: have permission; permission to delete files
learning.example:
A: You can edit this project folder, but do you have permission to delete files?
B: No. I'll keep the files and confirm the scope with you first.
A: Also ask before installing packages or publishing changes.
B: Understood. I'll stay within the actions you've approved.
learning.exampleChinese:
A: 你可以编辑这个项目文件夹，但你有权限删除文件吗？
B: 没有。我会保留文件，并先与你确认操作范围。
A: 安装依赖包或发布改动前也要先询问。
B: 明白。我会限定在你已经批准的操作范围内。

learning.sceneConnection: 删除是被限制的操作，并未实际发生；不为它编造可见框。
learning.association: 删除是被限制的操作，并未实际发生；不为它编造可见框。
learning.example: You can edit this project folder, but do you have permission to delete files?
learning.exampleChinese: 你可以编辑这个项目文件夹，但你有权限删除文件吗？

learning.sceneConnection: 确认范围是对白中的承诺，不从指向动作认定已经确认。
learning.association: 确认范围是对白中的承诺，不从指向动作认定已经确认。
learning.collocation: confirm the scope; confirm a requirement
learning.example: No. I'll keep the files and confirm the scope with you first.
learning.exampleChinese: 没有。我会保留文件，并先与你确认操作范围。

learning.sceneConnection: 显示器上清楚可见的文件夹图标对应对话中的项目目录；局部框仅指向图标，权限另由对白支持。
learning.association: 显示器上清楚可见的文件夹图标对应对话中的项目目录；局部框仅指向图标，权限另由对白支持。
learning.collocation: a project folder; edit a folder
learning.example: You can edit this project folder, but do you have permission to delete files?
learning.exampleChinese: 你可以编辑这个项目文件夹，但你有权限删除文件吗？
